card.name: Space before big projected numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a large figure in statements about population, food, energy or growth, e.g. 'to feed an extra', 'has doubled to', 'will represent'. It fires when a number is about to come next.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The blank space token just before a large quantity or projection in population, climate or energy text.

modes.label: Word before a quantity
modes.description: A small word such as extra, a or $ that leads straight into a big amount.
modes.example: To feed an<< extra>> 2 billion mouths over the next

card.writes: It mostly promotes odd, unrelated tokens and suppresses words like popular and widespread, so there is no clear output effect on the next word.
card.plain: It lights up just before a large number is given in a statement about growing populations, food or resources.
